messages:
incident-bot: Pager: 2xx error spike + container crashloop detected in runtime-pool-us-east-2 (gpu-12). Service: runtime-engine. Symptoms: OOM followed by SIGSEGV in fused_kernel. Investigate :pager:

oncall-olivia: I'm on it. Pulling logs from node gpu-12 now.

eng-sre-sam: Confirming crashloop: kube pod runtime-engine-5f6d7 restarting every ~20s on node gpu-12. Crash reason in container logs: 'free(): invalid pointer' then 'Segmentation fault (core dumped)'.

eng-runtime-miguel: Attaching to last crash log snippet: ```
[2026-03-17T01:02:03Z] runtime-engine: kv_cache.c:214 free_kv(): Assertion failed
[2026-03-17T01:02:03Z] runtime-engine: fused_kernel.c:982 compute_forward(): segfault at 0x7fffbadf
```

eng-ml-kyla: This matches a pattern we saw with the new TRT fused-attn patch on certain sequence lengths. Which model/variant is serving?

eng-sre-sam: Variant annotated on the pod: model: llama-13b-trt-fused-v2, quant: int8. Recent rollout started 03/16 22:40 UTC.

eng-runtime-miguel: Steps I propose: 1) cordon node gpu-12 to prevent new pods scheduling 2) drain non-critical pods 3) scale down the problematic deployment to 0 and rollback to previous model variant 4) preserve core dumps and NVML logs for postmortem.

infra-ops-lee: Cordon done. Marked node unschedulable: `kubectl cordon gpu-12` ✅

eng-sre-sam: Draining non-critical workloads, keeping runtime-engine so we can grab core: `kubectl drain gpu-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --pod-selector='!critical'`

eng-runtime-miguel: Created a debug pod and copied /var/crash/core.runtime-engine.* and nvml logs. Tarball: `s3://redwood-debug/2865512345/gpu-12.tar.gz`. Core present: core.runtime-engine.1234.

eng-ml-kyla: Rolling back model variant for runtime-route /v1/generate to llama-13b-trt-fused-v1 (pre-rollout). Patch rolling now: `kubectl set image deployment/runtime-engine runtime-engine=registry/redwood/runtime-engine:stable-20260316`

customer-success-jordan: Notifying affected customers: CS alert queued for any tenant with >0.5% 5xx rate in last 10m. No broad outage reported yet but some higher latency and errors for a subset of customers on us-east.

eng-sre-sam: After rollback, pods are stable on other nodes. We see successful starts on gpu-4 and gpu-9. Restarted 3 replicas on stable variant. Error rate dropping.

eng-runtime-miguel: While rollback mitigates customer impact, we still need root cause. Core shows invalid free in kv_cache.c around eviction logic when sequence length >4096. I'll open a debug branch and add bounds checks.

infra-ops-lee: Collecting kernel dmesg and nvcc driver logs, sending to hw vendor. nvml shows OOM events ~10s before segfault. Could be a double-free triggered by OOM path.

eng-ml-kyla: For quick safety, disable auto-quant fused kernel across rollout channels and add an SLI guard to block model variant rollout until regression tests pass.

oncall-olivia: Handoff: I'm handing to Miguel for postmortem follow-through and to Sam for infra follow-up. Leaving the channel but reachable on call. :wave:

eng-runtime-miguel: Taking over. I'll run reproducer with sequence lengths 4096-8192 on a test GPU, instrument the eviction code, and push a hotfix. ETA initial patch + canary in 3 hours.

eng-sre-sam: Monitoring alert cleared: 5xx error rate back to baseline after rollback and cordon. Closing pager for now; will reopen if we see reoccurrence.

customer-success-jordan: Sending a brief summary to impacted customers with ETA for patch. Noted no data exfiltration, only transient errors and higher latency.

incident-bot: Incident update: severity reduced to SEV-3. Attachments: s3://redwood-debug/2865512345/gpu-12.tar.gz, ticket #INC-2026-311.
